tools.name: list_indexed_services
tools.description: List every OG-image, screenshot and template service in the index with its published prices and the page each price was read from. No AI, no estimation - only values copied from vendor pages.

tools.name: get_service_prices
tools.description: Get the published plans and the derived USD-per-unit cost for one service, with the source URL and the date it was read.

tools.name: compare_services
tools.description: Compare two services on the cheapest published monthly price. Refuses to compare when one of them publishes no monthly subscription (returns comparable:false with the reason).

tools.name: get_cheapest_by_category
tools.description: Return the cheapest published monthly price per category, with the source URL of each price.

tools.name: get_index_metadata
tools.description: Report when this index was last read from the vendor pages, how many services it covers, and what it explicitly does not claim.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Report whether this service is up and which version answered.
